title: Trả lời Email (Q8)
description: Đọc email và viết câu trả lời phù hợp. Tối thiểu 30 từ.

items.email:
From: Manager
To: You
Subject: Team Building Event

Hi,

We are planning a team building event next Saturday. The event will include outdoor activities and a lunch. Please let me know if you can attend and if you have any dietary restrictions.

Thanks,
Manager
items.question: Viết email trả lời (tối thiểu 30 từ): Xác nhận tham dự và nêu yêu cầu ăn uống (nếu có).
items.sample:
Dear Manager,

Thank you for the invitation. I am happy to confirm that I will be able to attend the team building event next Saturday. Regarding dietary restrictions, I am vegetarian, so I would appreciate it if there could be some vegetarian options for lunch.

I look forward to the event.

Best regards,
[Your name]

items.email:
From: Client
To: You
Subject: Meeting Reschedule

Dear Sir/Madam,

I need to reschedule our meeting planned for tomorrow at 2 PM. Would it be possible to move it to Thursday at 10 AM instead?

Best regards,
Client
items.question: Viết email trả lời (tối thiểu 30 từ): Đồng ý đổi lịch hoặc đề xuất thời gian khác.
items.sample:
Dear Client,

Thank you for letting me know. Thursday at 10 AM works perfectly for me. I have updated my calendar accordingly.

Please do not hesitate to reach out if you need to make any further changes.

Best regards,
[Your name]
